title_en: Apartment for sale in Siri Kodra
description_en: The apartment is in an existing building, without an elevator, it is the 4th floor, not the last. It has 2 bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, an anteroom or a study-work room, 2 bathrooms, both with windows, 2 balconies. It is 99.54 m2, all usable surface. It is totally renovated and furnished. It is sold on credit, it is as collateral. The declaration is made according to the agreement and the price is slightly negotiated.
